examples.translation: I am going to Madrid.

examples.translation: I live in Seville.

examples.targetHTML: Trabaja en un restaurante cerca.
examples.translation: Works at a restaurant nearby.

examples.translation: We travel in July.

examples.targetHTML: Nació en 1998.
examples.translation: Was born in 1998.

examples.targetHTML: Estará listo en cinco minutos.
examples.translation: It will be ready in five minutes.

examples.translation: Thank you for coming.

examples.targetHTML: Lucharon por sus derechos.
examples.translation: They fought for their rights.

examples.translation: Paid ten euros for the ticket.

examples.translation: Looked through the train window.

examples.translation: The cat entered through the balcony.

relations.rule: Means “a / an”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.
relations.translation: I have a friend in Madrid.

examples.targetHTML: Tengo un amigo en Madrid.
examples.translation: I have a friend in Madrid.

examples.targetHTML: Tomemos un café caliente juntos.
examples.translation: Let's have a warm coffee together.

examples.targetHTML: Compré un libro muy interesante.
examples.translation: I bought a very interesting book.

examples.targetHTML: Fue un día inolvidable para todos.
examples.translation: It was an unforgettable day for everyone.

examples.targetHTML: Buscamos un lugar tranquilo para charlar.
examples.translation: We are looking for a quiet place to chat.

relations.rule: Means “a / an”. Use the form that matches the noun’s gender and number.

examples.targetHTML: Es una buena idea.
examples.translation: It is a good idea.

examples.targetHTML: Alquilamos una casa cerca de la playa.
examples.translation: We rented a house near the beach.

examples.targetHTML: Quiero hacer una pregunta rápida.
examples.translation: I want to ask a quick question.

examples.targetHTML: Contó una historia emocionante.
examples.translation: Told an exciting story.

examples.targetHTML: Esperamos durante una semana entera.
examples.translation: We waited for a whole week.

relations.formulaHTML: an item / idea + y + an item / idea
relations.rule: Joins items, ideas or actions.

examples.targetHTML: Compré pan y leche.
examples.translation: I bought bread and milk.

examples.targetHTML: Se levantó temprano y salió a correr.
examples.translation: Got up early and went out to run.

examples.targetHTML: Cantan y bailan con alegría.
examples.translation: They sing and dance with joy.

examples.targetHTML: El día era fresco y despejado.
examples.translation: The day was cool and clear.

examples.targetHTML: Escuchó la pregunta y asintió en silencio.
examples.translation: Heard the question and nodded in silence.

relations.formulaHTML: what happens + pero + a contrasting idea
relations.rule: Adds a contrasting idea or an unexpected difference.
relations.translation: I wanted to go out, but it was raining.

examples.targetHTML: Quería salir, pero llovía.
examples.translation: I wanted to go out, but it was raining.

examples.targetHTML: Lo intenté con todas mis fuerzas, pero no pude.
examples.translation: I tried with all my might, but couldn't.

examples.targetHTML: Sabía la lección, pero se puso nervioso.
examples.translation: Knew the lesson, but got nervous.

examples.targetHTML: Es caro, pero vale la pena.
examples.translation: It is expensive, but worth it.

examples.targetHTML: Buscó por doquier, pero la carta había desaparecido.
examples.translation: Searched everywhere, but the letter had vanished.

relations.rule: Gives a possible situation and what happens if it is true.
relations.targetHTML: Si tienes tiempo, ven a verme.
relations.translation: If you have time, come see me.

examples.targetHTML: Si tienes tiempo, ven a verme.
examples.translation: If you have time, come see me.

examples.targetHTML: Si llueve mañana, nos quedaremos en casa.
examples.translation: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

examples.targetHTML: Si quieres, podemos almorzar juntos.
examples.translation: If you want, we can have lunch together.

examples.targetHTML: Si puedes ayudarme, te lo agradezco.
examples.translation: If you can help me, I appreciate it.

examples.targetHTML: Si sabes algo nuevo, avísame enseguida.
examples.translation: If you know anything new, let me know right away.

relations.formulaHTML: verb + como + what you compare with
relations.rule: Compares how something is done with another example.

examples.targetHTML: Canta como un pájaro.
examples.translation: Sings like a bird.

examples.targetHTML: Corre rápido como el viento.
examples.translation: Runs fast like the wind.

examples.targetHTML: Brilla como el oro puro bajo el sol.
examples.translation: Shines like pure gold under the sun.

examples.targetHTML: Actuó como un verdadero profesional.
examples.translation: Acted like a true professional.

examples.targetHTML: Habla español tan claro como un nativo.
examples.translation: Speaks Spanish as clearly as a native.

relations.rule: Shows the role or job someone has in a situation.
relations.targetHTML: Trabaja como médico en el hospital central.
relations.translation: Works as a doctor in the central hospital.

examples.targetHTML: Trabaja como médico en el hospital central.
examples.translation: Works as a doctor in the central hospital.

examples.targetHTML: Actuó como representante oficial.
examples.translation: Acted as official representative.

examples.targetHTML: Participa como voluntaria en la biblioteca.
examples.translation: Participates as a volunteer in the library.

examples.targetHTML: Te hablo como amigo sincero.
examples.translation: I speak to you as a sincere friend.

examples.targetHTML: Declaró como testigo del suceso.
examples.translation: Testified as a witness of the event.

relations.rule: Shows who something belongs to: “my”.

examples.targetHTML: Esta es mi casa.
examples.translation: This is my house.

examples.targetHTML: Es mi mejor amigo desde la infancia.
examples.translation: He is my best friend since childhood.

examples.targetHTML: Mi hermano mayor vive en Barcelona.
examples.translation: My older brother lives in Barcelona.

examples.targetHTML: He dedicado toda mi vida a este trabajo.
examples.translation: I have dedicated my whole life to this work.

examples.targetHTML: Mi coche está aparcado enfrente.
examples.translation: My car is parked in front.

relations.rule: Shows who something belongs to: “his / her / their / your (formal)”.
relations.translation: What is your (formal) / his / her name?

examples.targetHTML: ¿Cuál es su nombre?
examples.translation: What is your (formal) / his / her name?

examples.targetHTML: Su familia es muy amable y acogedora.
examples.translation: His family is very kind and welcoming.

examples.targetHTML: Admiro mucho su trabajo profesional.
examples.translation: I admire his professional work very much.

examples.targetHTML: Su opinión es fundamental para nosotros.
examples.translation: Your (formal) opinion is essential for us.

examples.targetHTML: Visité su casa de campo el fin de semana.
examples.translation: I visited his country house on the weekend.

relations.rule: Shows who something belongs to: “your (informal)”.

examples.targetHTML: Tu casa es preciosa.
examples.translation: Your house is lovely.

examples.targetHTML: Me gusta mucho tu idea para el proyecto.
examples.translation: I like your idea for the project a lot.

examples.targetHTML: ¿Cómo está tu familia?
examples.translation: How is your family?

examples.targetHTML: Ayer conocí a tu amigo Carlos.
examples.translation: Yesterday I met your friend Carlos.

examples.targetHTML: Felicidades por tu nuevo trabajo.
examples.translation: Congratulations on your new job.

relations.rule: Means “I”. Names who does the action; the pronoun can often be left out.

examples.targetHTML: Yo sé la verdad.
examples.translation: I know the truth.

examples.targetHTML: Yo pienso que deberíamos intentarlo.
examples.translation: I think that we should try it.

examples.targetHTML: Yo no tengo ninguna duda al respecto.
examples.translation: I have no doubt about it.

examples.targetHTML: Yo quiero acompañarte al centro.
examples.translation: I want to accompany you downtown.

examples.targetHTML: Yo estoy listo cuando tú digas.
examples.translation: I am ready whenever you say.

relations.rule: Means “you”. Names who does the action; the pronoun can often be left out.
relations.targetHTML: Tú sabes lo que quiero decir.

examples.targetHTML: Tú sabes lo que quiero decir.
examples.translation: You know what I mean.

examples.targetHTML: Tú tienes toda la razón en esto.
examples.translation: You are completely right on this.

examples.targetHTML: Si tú puedes venir, será genial.
examples.translation: If you can come, it will be great.

examples.targetHTML: Tú entiendes mejor que nadie la situación.
examples.translation: You understand the situation better than anyone.

examples.targetHTML: Tú decides qué camino tomar.
examples.translation: You decide which path to take.

relations.rule: Refers to an idea, situation or thing already mentioned or near the listener.

examples.targetHTML: Eso es verdad.
examples.translation: That is true.

examples.targetHTML: Eso parece una magnífica solución.
examples.translation: That looks like a magnificent solution.

examples.targetHTML: Eso cambia las cosas por completo.
examples.translation: That changes things completely.

examples.targetHTML: Eso no significa que sea fácil.
examples.translation: That does not mean that it is easy.

examples.targetHTML: Precisamente por eso vine a hablar contigo.
examples.translation: Precisely because of that I came to talk to you.

relations.rule: Refers to a thing or idea close to the speaker or being introduced now.

examples.targetHTML: Esto es para ti.
examples.translation: This is for you.

examples.targetHTML: Esto funciona a la perfección.
examples.translation: This works to perfection.

examples.targetHTML: Esto parece muy interesante.
examples.translation: This looks very interesting.

examples.targetHTML: Esto me gusta cada día más.
examples.translation: I like this more every day.

examples.targetHTML: Esto apenas comienza.
examples.translation: This is only just beginning.

relations.rule: Refers to everything in the situation.

examples.targetHTML: Todo está bien.
examples.translation: Everything is fine.

examples.targetHTML: Todo salió según lo planeado.
examples.translation: Everything turned out as planned.

examples.targetHTML: Todo cambió de un momento a otro.
examples.translation: Everything changed from one moment to the next.

examples.targetHTML: Entendí todo sin ninguna dificultad.
examples.translation: I understood everything without any difficulty.

examples.targetHTML: Todo quedó en calma tras la lluvia.
examples.translation: Everything remained calm after the rain.

previewSlotNotes.issue: The focus word is an object before no following verb here; this example needs a separate word-order pattern.

relations.rule: Refers to an unspecified thing or amount.

examples.targetHTML: Quiero comer algo.
examples.translation: I want to eat something.

examples.targetHTML: Tiene algo importante que contarnos.
examples.translation: Has something important to tell us.

examples.targetHTML: ¿Ha pasado algo mientras estaba fuera?
examples.translation: Did something happen while I was away?

examples.targetHTML: Sé algo sobre este tema histórico.
examples.translation: I know something about this historical topic.

examples.targetHTML: Te traje algo del viaje que te gustará.
examples.translation: I brought you something from the trip you will like.

relations.rule: Gives the reason why something happens.
relations.translation: I did not go because I was tired.

examples.targetHTML: No fui porque estaba cansado.
examples.translation: I did not go because I was tired.

examples.targetHTML: Nos quedamos porque empezó a llover.
examples.translation: We stayed because it started raining.

examples.targetHTML: Estudio español porque me encanta viajar.
examples.translation: I study Spanish because I love traveling.

examples.targetHTML: Sonrió porque recibió buenas noticias.
examples.translation: Smiled because he received good news.

examples.targetHTML: Te pregunto porque me importa tu opinión.
examples.translation: I ask you because your opinion matters to me.

relations.rule: Connects an event to the time or situation when it happens.

examples.targetHTML: Cuando llegué, todos sonrieron.
examples.translation: When I arrived, everyone smiled.

examples.targetHTML: Cuando puedas, pásate por mi oficina.
examples.translation: When you can, drop by my office.

examples.targetHTML: Cuando sale el sol, la plaza se llena de gente.
examples.translation: When the sun rises, the square fills with people.

examples.targetHTML: Cuando era niño, vivía cerca del mar.
examples.translation: When I was a boy, I lived near the sea.

examples.targetHTML: Cuando despertó, el tren ya había llegado.
examples.translation: When he woke up, the train had already arrived.
